step1_about.description: Full-service event entertainment company serving Minnesota and surrounding areas. Over 75 years of combined entertainment experience across our team. We specialize in DJ entertainment, MC services, live musicians, photo booths, lighting design, and event production for weddings, Bar/Bat Mitzvahs, corporate events, birthday parties, school dances, and private celebrations. We employ the best and most requested talent in the industry — from highly interactive entertainers to expert musicologists. Our difference is our entertainers. We make every event unforgettable.

step2_vision.target_audience: Couples planning weddings, families planning Bar/Bat Mitzvahs and celebrations, corporate event planners, party hosts — anyone in Minnesota who wants premium entertainment that fills the dance floor and creates unforgettable memories
step2_vision.unique_selling_point: 75+ years combined experience. Our entertainers are the difference — not just DJs, but true entertainers who read the room, interact with guests, and keep dance floors packed all night. We offer Mirror Me Booth and Mirror Air Booth (AI-powered photo experiences from Fotomaster). Full production capabilities from ceremony to last dance. Real reviews from real clients: 'Had everyone dancing from start to last song.'

step5_design.design_notes: Dark luxurious theme — deep navy/black background with gold accents and red highlights. Think premium nightclub meets elegant event venue. Hero section should feel energetic and exciting — like walking into the best party you've ever been to. Use stock photos of DJs performing, packed dance floors, wedding receptions, Bar Mitzvah celebrations, photo booth experiences, and uplighting. Cards for each service with icons. Testimonials as a carousel or card grid. Gallery should showcase different event types with filter buttons. Mobile-first responsive. The site should feel like the party has already started when you land on it. Bold typography. Smooth scroll animations. NOT a long scrolling page — use tabs, accordions, and navigation. Each page fits in 2-3 viewport heights max.

step6_contact.hours: Monday - Friday, 9am - 6pm CST | Weekends by appointment for events

step8_budget.additional_notes: This is a full-service entertainment company — NOT just a DJ service. The site must showcase the FULL range of services: DJ, MC, live musicians, photo booths (Mirror Me and Mirror Air from Fotomaster), lighting, video production, and event planning support. Bar/Bat Mitzvahs are a major specialty (20-30 per year) but the company does ALL events equally well — weddings, corporate, birthdays, school dances, private parties. Do NOT make it look like a mitzvah-only company. Show the breadth. The testimonials are real from The Knot and WeddingWire. Use stock photos of diverse events — dance floors, wedding first dances, kids at parties, corporate galas, photo booth fun, colorful uplighting. The Mirror Me Booth and Mirror Air Booth are premium add-ons that should have their own featured section. Gold/black/red color scheme should feel premium and exciting, not cheap or flashy.
